Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week — the team found the latency/tail behavior very encouraging. We have a couple of follow-ups on pricing for the ongoing POC before we loop Finance and Procurement:

- Your AE mentioned an "Accelerator Pack" (a fixed SKU that bundles 200k tokens + 12 engineering hrs) and a separate timeboxed option (30-day timeboxed evaluation billed by token/embeddings).
- Can you clarify whether we can unbundle the engineering hours from the SKU? Our security team prefers discrete line items for engineering support vs token usage.
- If we choose the Accelerator Pack but finish early, will we get a pro-rated credit or rollover?
- If we go timebox and need an extra 10 days, what is the typical extension path (credit vs additional fee)?

Subject: Re: Clarify packaging — 'Accelerator Pack' vs timeboxed pilot

Avery —

Thanks for the file and the clear questions. Short answers up front, details below:

1) Unbundling: Yes — we can present engineering hours as a separate line item. The Accelerator Pack is a convenience SKU (tokens + hours + priority queueing) but we can split it into Token Units + Professional Services (hour blocks) on the SOW.

2) Early finish / rollover: For the Accelerator SKU we offer one of two behaviors: a) Pro-rated credit applied to future hosted usage (valid for 90 days) or b) convert unused token units into a discounted invoice credit at 60% of list if you request invoice settlement. We can pick which path you prefer in writing.

3) Timebox extension: For the 30-day timeboxed pilot we typically grant a single 7–14 day extension. Operationally teams choose between: (i) a short extension (up to 10 days) in exchange for either a small top-up invoice (pro-rata token bucket) or (ii) we issue equivalent token credit if the extension is for troubleshooting rather than usage. If Procurement prefers no invoicing complexity, we can offer a 10-day extension as token credit on the next invoice.

Proposed commercial options (high level):
- Option A (Accelerator SKU, unbundled on SOW): $22k SKU = 200k tokens + 12 eng hrs. If unused: pro-rated credit (option a above).
- Option B (Timebox 30d): Monthly metered at $0.06/1k tokens + eng hrs billed separately at $250/hr. 10-day extension: additional 70k token top-up (~$4.2k) or convert to credit.

I'll attach a short addendum draft you can share with Procurement — Marissa, looping you for any legal/pricing guardrails.

If helpful, we can also build a simple mutual action plan (deliverables + dates + success criteria) to reduce the need for back-and-forth redlines.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hello Windward Procurement team —

Forwarding Ben's note with the proposed commercial options. A couple of clarifying bullets from Redwood Finance/Commercial:

- We can present line items exactly as Ben outlined (Tokens separate, Eng hours separate) on the SOW.
- Discounting: For new customers that commit to a Dedicated deployment within 90 days, we can add a one-time 15% off the Accelerator SKU. That is a one-time promotional credit applied to the initial invoice.
- Extensions: To avoid invoicing friction, we recommend using token credits for short pilot extensions (<=14 days). That keeps PO/Invoice counts low.
- Legal redlines: We rarely accept open-ended rollover beyond 90 days; if Windward needs long-term rollover, we need explicit contract language.

Ben — plz mark if you'd like me to include the 15% promo in the draft addendum.

Thanks,
